utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard we’re picking a new read soon, and I’m hoping it’s something juicy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we actually picking the new book soon? I’d like to know before I start guessing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard—should be soon, maybe at the next meeting. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss the update, so feel free to remind me if I forget.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll remind you if you forget, and I’ll let you know once the book club decides.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s a mystery novel this week—pretty sure everyone’s excited about it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, I’m in. Do you know the title and when we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d like to hear what you all are reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’ve got a little mix right now—one mystery, one memoir, and a novel someone keeps passing around. I can bring the list next time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thank you. I’m especially curious about the mystery.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work as long as it doesn’t land on school pickup day.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes total sense — let’s avoid school pickup day. I’ll check the options and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I appreciate it. Just let me know what days you find and I’ll see which one fits our schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the book club meeting—what are we reading, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—sorry, I’m a bit scattered. Let’s say we read the book I mentioned, and we can meet next Thursday evening at my place if that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—let’s keep it simple and meet next Thursday evening at your place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, you should come to book club this week — I think you’d really like it. We’re meeting at my place on Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday evening sounds a bit tight for me—I’d need to check my schedule and transit first. Could you send me the address and start time?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — it starts at 7:00 PM at my place, 14 Maple Street. I’ll send you the full address now, and if transit looks tricky, I can help you figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’d love to know what the book club is reading next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading "The Night Circus" next, and I’m really excited about it. I can bring a few extra copies and the meeting details if you’d like!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that would be lovely—thank you! I’d be glad to get the details and a copy if you have an extra.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you check the next meeting date and whether we’re doing snacks this time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll check the next meeting date and whether snacks are on the list for this time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might sit this one out, but thanks for thinking of me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Uli — we’ll miss you if you don’t make it, but there’s always next time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate the invite, and I’ll see how I’m feeling.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—if the book club needs any tools or a hand with setup, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you help set up the chairs before the meeting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—I can help set up the chairs before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the community center on Maple Street, right? If you want, I can double-check the time too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Maple Street sounds right to me. If you can check the time too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll check the time and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — if the book club needs anything handy, I’m happy to lend a tool or help set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll let you know if the book club needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Rey — just give me a holler if you need anything for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d like to know the date and where we’re meeting so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll confirm the date and the meeting place, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira — I appreciate that. Just send me the details when you have them so I can arrange everything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I was thinking we could get the book club crew together sometime this week. Want me to help pick a book or set a time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be lovely, Jules — I can help pick a book, and I’m free to sort out a time too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Mara — let’s pick a book first, then I’ll help line up a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and extra tea ready for book club—did you want me to bring anything else, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo—I'm probably going to be late, but I can bring a dessert if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane—dessert sounds perfect. I’ll save you a spot when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this month—sounds like it could be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds promising — I’ll need to check the school pickup times first, but I’d love to join if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, check the pickup times first — I can save you the details and let you know what they pick!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading a short mystery this month—easy to finish, but it should give us plenty to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds perfect for a busy month. What’s the title?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check and send you the title soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — just send it over when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re meeting this Thursday, and you should definitely come with me!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — thanks for the heads-up! I’d love to come with you on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll save you a seat and we can walk over together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the book club meets at the community center on Maple, but I can double-check the exact room if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, thanks. I like to have the room and time clear before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check the room and time so you have the details before you go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at your place for book club, and should I bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we're still meeting here at 7. Please bring snacks if you can, and I’ll check one more time on the tea.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring snacks. See you at 7.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club might be picking a new novel soon — I should ask around while I’m out. Have you heard what Oren’s leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I’m not sure yet—I keep forgetting the title, honestly. But I’m leaning toward something cozy, maybe a mystery or a short novel.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds like a good pick — I’ll ask around and see what names people are tossing out. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know.
